description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ellakkala, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District  - Cad. Map No. 510601
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in the Village of Ellakkala. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
